fieldValues.title: How does the owner review so that review is judgement, not clicking?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (6. Sovereignty: doing what the human is good at), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Review the story: a vignette and everything derived from it, side by side.
- B. Review what changed since the last look.
- C. Review only the low-confidence items.
- D. Review a sample, as an audit.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: How long each takes, and how often it changes a record. Session logs show seven ratifications in 47 seconds.
fieldValues.next_action: Try each form in one session and record the time and the changes made.
